subject: general
question: The work done by a constant force acting on a body is ______
solution:
The correct answer is __**either positive or negative**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The work done by a **constant force** on a body depends on the **direction of the force** relative to the direction of the **displacement** of the body.
 
• If the force is in the same direction as the displacement, the work done is **positive**.
 
• If the force is in the opposite direction to the displacement, the work done is **negative**.
 
• When the force and displacement are perpendicular to each other, the work done is **zero**.
 
• Therefore, the work done by a constant force can be **positive, negative, or zero**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **always zero**__

 __
 
• This option is incorrect because the work done by a constant force is not always zero.
 
• Work done can be zero only if the force is perpendicular to the displacement.
 
 
 
• **always positive**__
 __
 
• This option is incorrect because the work done by a constant force is not always positive.
 
• Work done is positive only if the force is in the same direction as the displacement.
 
 
 
• **always negative**__
 
 
• This option is incorrect because the work done by a constant force is not always negative.
 
• Work done is negative only if the force is in the opposite direction to the displacement.
